title: studio → pipelines: pause a batch
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.pause` (stream CMD) in the transaction that changes the batch; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`, n = the batch's command counter (submit = 1, +1 per later command). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines`, filter `cmd.pipeline.>`, one message at a time, in order). Pipelines starts no new rows and publishes evt.pipeline.batch `paused`. Studio already holds the batch's queued runs (the dispatcher skips them); running runs finish and their rows complete.
